provenance.source_title: Psychology of Dogs That Sleep With You (What They'

examples.psychological_goal: 用具体时间锚定一个电影感场景，第一秒完成沉浸
examples.expression_mechanism: 具体时间开场（it's 2 in the morning）
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个具体时间代替任何开场白，直接切进场景
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体时间；选与你场景匹配的时刻

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个可量化的生活细节制造'这就是我家'的认领感
examples.expression_mechanism: 伪精确测量的共鸣细节（exactly 80%）
examples.example_text: taking up exactly 80% of the space and leaving you the rest
examples.usage_instruction: 学习给共同痛点配上一个夸张但可信的量化细节
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该百分比；量化细节要换到你自己的场景

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话宣告常识将被推翻，悬挂主悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: 权威预告（science tells a completely different story）
examples.example_text: but behavioral neuroscience tells a completely different story
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在复述完常识后立即用权威来源宣告反转
examples.negative_instruction: 预告后必须快速兑现第一层证据，不可拖延

examples.psychological_goal: 给出解释行为底层逻辑的第一性原则
examples.expression_mechanism: 最高级原则陈述（the most vulnerable state）
examples.example_text: because sleep is the most vulnerable state any animal can be in
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句最高级原则作为整套推理的地基
examples.negative_instruction: 原则必须真正普适，不可为了气势而过度概括

examples.psychological_goal: 把心理学结论转化为观众与宠物之间的情感确认
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定负面标签 + 情感化重命名
examples.example_text: they're not being clingy they're telling you you're the safest thing in their world
examples.usage_instruction: 学习'不是X，是在告诉你Y'的重命名句式及其证据前置
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该重命名内容；情感落点必须由前文证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示机制的同时宣告其物种独特性
examples.expression_mechanism: 机制命名 + 唯一性声明
examples.example_text: it's a loop a self reinforcing neurochemical loop that no other animal on earth shares with humans
examples.usage_instruction: 学习给机制起短名（loop）后立刻接唯一性声明放大意义
examples.negative_instruction: 唯一性声明必须有对照组证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用对照组的彻底失败把独特性钉死
examples.expression_mechanism: 对照组一句话否定（didn't activate at all）
examples.example_text: the loop didn't activate at all
examples.usage_instruction: 学习对照组结果用极短句呈现，与前面长解释形成节奏落差
examples.negative_instruction: 不要省略对照组交代，直接喊'独一无二'

examples.psychological_goal: 用'没人想过问'的问题开启新的证据层级
examples.expression_mechanism: 冷门问题预告（almost nobody thinks to ask）
examples.example_text: here's a question almost nobody thinks to ask
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用问题的稀缺性而非答案的劲爆性来吸引注意
examples.negative_instruction: 问题必须真的出人意料且得到认真回答

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句定性把考古证据升华为关系证据
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定功能化 + 肯定情感化（not working animals, family）
examples.example_text: these weren't just working animals they were family
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在冷证据之后用一句关系定性释放情感
examples.negative_instruction: 定性必须由前文的具体细节（护理病犬）支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 在严肃研究叙述中插入一个身体感笑点降温
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化身体幽默（takes out your ankle）
examples.example_text: the occasional 3:00am stretch that takes out your ankle
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在研究数据描述中嵌入一个养宠人都懂的身体幽默
examples.negative_instruction: 幽默不得改变研究结论的严肃性

examples.psychological_goal: 呈现客观与主观相反的悖论核心
examples.expression_mechanism: 数据判决 + and yet 转折
examples.example_text: the data was worse and yet almost every single participant reported feeling more comfortable
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'and yet'直接并置相反证据制造悖论
examples.negative_instruction: 悖论后必须给机制解释，不可悬置

examples.psychological_goal: 彻底解除观众的负罪感并转化为珍视
examples.expression_mechanism: maybe 句式双重猜测（不是破坏，是修复）
examples.example_text: maybe your dog isn't ruining your sleep maybe they're restoring something more ancient than sleep hygiene
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用成对的 maybe 句先否定自责再给出更深的正面解释
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体重定义（sleep hygiene）

examples.psychological_goal: 把行为最终定性为双向生理事件，完成最高层级的重定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 定性短句 + 展开式长句
examples.example_text: it's a neurological event two separate nervous systems from two different species co regulating each other through the night
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给定性名词（event）再用一个长句展开其画面

examples.psychological_goal: 用排除式排比把'被选择感'推到情感顶点
examples.expression_mechanism: 排除法排比落点（not A, not B, you）
examples.example_text: your dog chose you not the couch not the floor
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾用逐项排除把焦点收到观众自身
examples.negative_instruction: 排除项必须来自前文出现过的具体选项

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句话回收全部证据，给出最终定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 最高级收束句（the safest place in their world）
examples.example_text: sleeping beside you is the safest place in their world
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾句与前文情感落点（1:47处）首尾呼应的复现手法
examples.negative_instruction: 收束句必须是前文已建立过的判断的回归，而非新结论
